hotels.name: Tandoor Corner
hotels.address: Crusher Chauk, MH SH 116, Kolhapur City, Maharashtra 416003
hotels.description: A Kolhapur institution where the clay oven never sleeps — Mughlai plates below, quiet rooms above.
hotels.about: For more than two decades, Tandoor Corner has fed Kolhapur from its kitchen at Crusher Chauk. The butter chicken has a following of its own, the tandoor is lit before sunrise, and the dining room has welcomed generations of families, travellers and late-night cravings. Upstairs, a handful of rooms keep the same warmth: crisp linen, brass lamplight, and the smell of fresh naan drifting up the stairwell. It is not a grand hotel — it is a delicious address that happens to let you sleep over.

room_types.name: Standard
room_types.desc: Compact, spotless and warm — made for travellers who spend their day out in the city and their night well rested.

room_types.name: Deluxe
room_types.desc: A king bed, a window seat over the street, and enough room to stretch after a long thali.

room_types.name: Suite
room_types.desc: A living room of your own, a bath worth lingering in, and dinner downstairs whenever you please.

hotels.name: Shahu Palace
hotels.address: Ramling Road, near Shahu Palace, Kolhapur, Maharashtra 416003
hotels.description: Heritage rooms beside the old palace — arched verandahs, and Kolhapur at your doorstep.
hotels.about: Shahu Palace sits where the city's old quarter begins, a short walk from the palace gates and the famous Mahalaxmi temple. The building itself is a century of Kolhapur in miniature: teak doors, jaali balconies, courtyards that catch the morning sun. Our rooms have been restored with a light hand — original plaster and brass alongside modern baths and deep mattresses. The kitchen serves a Kolhapuri thali that locals queue for, and guests simply walk downstairs.

room_types.name: Standard
room_types.desc: Heritage charm at its simplest — high ceilings, cool floors and a window onto the courtyard.

room_types.name: Deluxe
room_types.desc: Carved balcony, king bed and the quiet of the old wing — our most requested room.

room_types.name: Suite
room_types.desc: The old wing's finest — a parlour, a four-poster bed and a balcony over Ramling Road.

hotels.name: Panhala Fort Retreat
hotels.description: A hill retreat above the old ramparts, where fort sunrises and slow mornings share a verandah.
hotels.about: Forty minutes from Kolhapur, the road to Panhala climbs through mango orchards and mist. The Retreat sits just below the old fort walls, where dawn arrives with paragliders and the smell of wet earth. Rooms are stone and timber, each with a verandah facing the valley; the kitchen leans local — misal at breakfast, mutton at night, and coffee that earns the sunrise. Walk the ramparts at dusk, then come back to a fire in the courtyard.

room_types.name: Standard
room_types.desc: Stone-walled and snug, with a valley-facing window and a kettle that's always warm.

room_types.name: Deluxe
room_types.desc: A private verandah, a king bed, and the Sahyadris performing at every hour of light.

room_types.name: Suite
room_types.desc: Our corner suites wrap the view — living room, bath with a view, and a fire below.

hotels.name: The Riverside Inn
hotels.address: Tarabai Park, Bhogawati River Road, Kolhapur, Maharashtra 416005
hotels.description: Crisp, contemporary rooms on the river — ten minutes from the station, zero noise from the city.
hotels.about: The Riverside Inn was built for people with early trains and late meetings, but it refuses to feel like an office. Glass walls face the Bhogawati, the lobby smells of filter coffee, and every room is engineered for sleep: blackout curtains, silent air-conditioning, a bed that means it. Downstairs, the all-day café serves everything from a Kolhapuri breakfast to a midnight sandwich. Parking, printers and a boardroom — all present, none of it showy.

room_types.name: Standard
room_types.desc: Everything a working night needs: a proper desk, fast Wi-Fi and perfect silence.

room_types.name: Deluxe
room_types.desc: River-facing glass, a king bed and a lounge chair for the ones who made their deadline.

room_types.name: Suite
room_types.desc: A suite that works as hard as you do — meeting nook, deep bath, river on both sides.

hotels.name: Vasant Villa Resort
hotels.tagline: Garden villas & a long blue pool
hotels.description: Villas in a frangipani garden, a long pool, and evenings that end by the water.
hotels.about: Ten minutes off the highway, Vasant Villa feels a world away — cream stone villas scattered through a garden of frangipani and palm, a pool that runs the length of the lawn, and a restaurant where dinner is served under string lights. Weekends bring families; weekdays bring people who finally switched their phones off. Every villa has its own sit-out, and the staff learn your coffee order by day two.

room_types.name: Standard
room_types.desc: A garden-facing room with a sit-out — mornings here begin with birds, not alarms.

room_types.name: Deluxe
room_types.desc: Poolside luxury with a private deck, daybed and the water ten steps away.

room_types.name: Suite
room_types.desc: A villa to yourself — plunge pool, lawn, and a chef who cooks for your table alone.
